\caption{Language-modelling quality after nanochat depth-12 pretraining on ClimbMix, for vocabulary-matched tokenizers trained on fineweb\_en\_5gb. bpb/byte is validation loss summed over the true UTF-8 length of the evaluation text, so it is comparable across schemes that tokenize the same text into different numbers of tokens. Every figure is absolute, and $\pm$ is a scheme's own sample standard deviation over 3 runs per scheme, except \bnds{wpd} under BPE with 6. \textbf{Bold} is best in a column and \underline{underline} runner-up. Every scheme improves on \plainscheme{} at $p<0.01$, by a two-sided paired $t$-test over the 3 seeds both ran: one data permutation per seed is shared across schemes, so differencing at equal seed cancels it and leaves a spread several times tighter than the $\pm$ above. -- is a configuration that was not pretrained. Compression for these same tokenizers is in Table~\ref{tab:intrinsic-main}.}
